{"code":"import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq').drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='last')

# Check the shape after deduplication
print(f"Deduplicated shape: {df_dedup.shape}")
print(df_dedup.head())"}
